title: TempTarget-triggered loop run does not see TT itself
symptom: When a new temp target is received from Nightscout, the loop run triggered by the event does not see the temp target as set (temptargetSet: false), potentially disabling safety features like 'allow smb on high tt'.
cause: The loop was triggered by the first TT change before the second TT was applied, due to sequential processing of records from NS causing issues.
fix: The issue was addressed by improving the area to process records coming from NS in batch, which was mentioned as a recent improvement. The user was advised to wait for the next release.
evidence_quote: Here is this problem that loop was triggered by 1st change before second was applied
